fixtures.preview: United visit Anfield (4:30pm UK, 3:30am Mon 23 Nov Sydney) sitting 18th and fresh off a chaotic 4-4 draw with Aston Villa.
talking_points: United are 18th with 8 points from 10 games, in the relegation zone and below the line for the first time at this stage of a season in 40 years.
They came from 2-0 down twice against Villa, a Premier League first, with Patrick Dorgu's 90+6 header earning the draw and some respite for Michael Carrick.
United have yet to keep a clean sheet in 10 league games, the first time that has happened since 1986-87.
Injury and line-up news for both sides isn't confirmed yet; none was reported in the match reports I read.

fixtures.preview: Matchday 5 in Lisbon (8pm local, 7am Thu 26 Nov Sydney), a week after Anfield and after United's 3-2 win over Roma on 3 Nov.
Brentford visit Old Trafford on Saturday 28 Nov at 3pm UK time (2am Sun 29 Nov Sydney).
A Wednesday-night trip to Tyneside at 8pm UK time (7am Thu 3 Dec Sydney); fixtures are subject to change.
Coventry visit Old Trafford on Saturday 5 Dec at 3pm UK time (2am Sun 6 Dec Sydney).
Matchweek 5 in Brisbane (6:40pm Brisbane time, 7:40pm Sydney), after Sydney's 4-1 home win over Central Coast on 6 Nov.
talking_points: Al Hassan Toure hit a hat-trick (31', 42', 50') in the 4-1 win over the Mariners, and Gabriel Popovic scored his first goal for the club.
Coach Patrick Kisnorbo said after that win that 'the best is yet to come'.
Loan signing Jacob Farrell was in the extended squad for the Mariners game and is in line for a debut; the squad for Brisbane isn't confirmed.
No injury list or current ladder position was found, so availability is unconfirmed.

notes: Many club, venue, ticketing and supermarket pages blocked access or returned thin results, so some details come from search results and third-party listings.

Man Utd: fixtures come from Sky Sports and UEFA; the 4-4 Villa details (18th, 8 points, Carrick) come from The Analyst and Sports Mole. Liverpool's form and any team news were not found, and one search result gave 21 Nov for the Anfield game, but Sky Sports lists Sun 22 Nov 4:30pm. Stan Sport is confirmed as the Premier League and Champions League home in Australia.
Sydney FC: Brisbane (6:40pm) and Auckland (5pm) times come from the A-Leagues page with no stated time zone, so they are treated as local times. No ladder or injury list was found.

Big matches: Champions League kick-offs use UEFA's default 21:00 CET. The Socceroos v Jordan friendly (17 Nov local) has no confirmed time, so it isn't listed. Nations Championship finals-weekend teams are still to be decided.

Local: no local news from the last 7 days was found. School events come from the Term 4 calendar and the Week 5 Principal Update (dates may change); nothing was found for the second school or South Eveleigh (its events page returned an error). Adaptive tennis was dropped because its year couldn't be confirmed.
Live sport: no Sydney tennis, rugby union or Matildas games were found in the window; the Kings game venue is named as on the NBL page.

Arts: Robbie Williams, Iron Maiden, Benson Boone, Whispering Jack, Silver Tongue, Aldous Harding, Wolf Alice and Hoodoo Gurus were carried from earlier runs and their prices weren't re-opened. Gigs seen on Sydney Music's gig guide (e.g. Kip Moore, Enmore, Fri 13 Nov) were left out for space.

Son and daughter: nothing confirmed for Sydney Pokémon, Minecraft or Roblox events, a junior parkrun near home, or kids' author events in Sydney. Sydney FC's site mentions summer holiday football clinics for ages 5–13, but dates weren't checked.
Groceries: half-price lines come from an OzBargain roundup of the 11–17 Nov catalogues; no half-price fresh fruit, veg, eggs or nuts were listed. Aldi items have no was-price.
Deals: the FUCCBOIS free-ticket offer was skipped as it looks adult-themed. Horizon was carried over, with Diana Ross updated and BTS added; other entries weren't re-researched.
